description: Foxconn T99W175 / Dell Snapdragon X55 in MBIM composition (05c6:90d5, AT^USBSWITCH=90d5). Matched by the ID and cdc_mbim alone: in MBIM ModemManager reads the firmware's own MBIM identity, «Generic Mobile Broadband Adapter» with USB strings Microsoft / Generic Mobile Broadband Adapter, not DELL Snapdragon X55 as in QMI (bench 2026-10-28, OPi Zero 3, firmware T99W175.F0.6.0.0.6.GC.004 056: it fell back to generic-mbim). The same ID is used by the Compal RXM-G1 prototype: compal-rxm-g1-05c6-90d5 takes it by ModemManager's model and outscores this one, as another modem manager tells them apart (the Compal names, Foxconn otherwise). No kernel table names 05c6:90d5 for a serial driver, so the composition shows no tty (the bench: 00 ff/ff/30, 01 ff/42/01 ADB, 02-03 MBIM, 04 ff/ff/ff, 05 ff/ff/40, none bound); the AT port is taken as interface 05 (ff/ff/40), the platform's modem port by its protocol: the same T99 in 1e2d:00b3 MBIM shows 02 ff/ff/40, 04 ff/ff/60, 05 ff/ff/30 DIAG, 06 ADB (HANDOFF 238), and the QMI composition's MODEM is its 02. Bound as the QMI composition is on the owner's unit (option, DIAG and the modem port; ADB, the ff/ff/ff port and MBIM left alone); field-reported, not bench-validated in MBIM. QMI services also answer inside MBIM (qmicli --device-open-mbim), which the antennas read already uses. Sources: the modem zoo page foxconn-t99w175 (05c6:90d5 MBIM, 05c6:9025 QMI), HANDOFF 82 (the switch and its hazards), 4PDA 1102595 (a manual serial binding for 90d5)

hints.at_source: 05c6:90d5: 00 ff/ff/30 DIAG, 01 ff/42/01 ADB, 02-03 MBIM, 04 ff/ff/ff, 05 ff/ff/40 (bench report 2026-10-28, OPi Zero 3, no driver on any); the modem port by its protocol as in 1e2d:00b3 (HANDOFF 238). ModemManager ignores this modem's ttys (mm_ports control), so the engine needs the number

recovery.source: as the QMI composition (foxconn-t99w175-qmi): radio and reset through ModemManager; not bench-validated in MBIM

radio.source: another modem manager 3.4.0 _qualcomm_sdx55_common (AT^SLMODE mask 1 WCDMA, 2 LTE, 4 NR5G, 0 auto; AT^BAND_PREF=<tech>,2,<list> unquoted, never the bare reset); QModem vendor/foxconn.sh (the same SLMODE table, NR5G_NSA/NR5G_SA lines)

ussd_cs_fallback.source: bench 2026-10-16 (T99W175, Tele2): USSD on LTE fell back to a 3G cell, was rejected (SupsFailureCase) and the data session dropped; ModemManager showed cs 'searching' while eps was 'home'

bind.source: no kernel serial driver knows 05c6:90d5 (the bench report: no tty); another modem manager binds it by new_id and frees ADB, 4PDA 1102595 a manual binding working; scoped as the QMI composition's on the same unit
